title: Ai Product Builder
description:
AI Product Builder Improvado is an AI-powered, unified platform designed for marketing teams in medium to large-scale enterprises and agencies, who are looking to automate complex marketing intelligence and reporting to make decisions with ease.

Improvado gathers, organizes, and untangles marketing data to deliver instant insights through BI and AI, helping to eliminate complexity, delivering laser-focused insights to optimize budgets, enhance campaign efficiency and marketing ROI.

About the role As an AI Product Builder you own one product area end to end.

Which area depends on where we need you most, and the work is the same in all of them.

Our products turn marketing data into decisions, and each of them has the same failure mode: it tells the customer something and stops there.

Your job is to find where your area stops short of causing a decision, build the part that closes that gap, and show that somebody acted.

You will build hands-on with AI, shape the roadmap, work directly with engineering teams and with customers, and decide what a good recommendation looks like for a different persona on the same data - a media buyer, an analyst and a CMO do not want the same thing.

Responsibilities Own the product area end to end, from idea to delivery, and define how the roadmap evolves Close the gap between what the product reports and what the customer does about it: decide what gets recommended and to whom, and build the loop that makes those recommendations better over time Work hands-on with AI, from mockups and prototypes through to production code for smaller features, alongside an engineering team of three to ten people Run customer discovery yourself and turn it into roadmap decisions Define and measure the metrics that prove the product caused someone to act Build and maintain automated workflows using AI tools, scripting and the modern data stack Collaborate with Product, BI and CSM teams on architecture decisions and customer data requirements Qualities Product ownership experience - able to take a problem end to end with minimal hand-holding, and point at things you built that are still in use Demonstrated use of AI tools in daily work: Claude Code, agentic coding, prompt engineering, with a clear view of what you deliberately do not delegate Experience building an AI agent and making it reliable in production Marketing or revenue data domain experience, and you have computed those metrics yourself rather than receiving them from an analyst Comfortable working with engineers as a peer rather than across a handoff Strong SQL ; Python for data processing and automation Fluent English - there are customer calls and escalations in this role Availability to overlap US Pacific business hours (or at least East) Nice to have Hands-on ETL/ELT pipeline experience (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or ClickHouse) Experience working directly with clients on technical requirements BI tools (e.g. Superset) for operational reporting Process A screening call, a 45-minute call with the VP of Product, a take-home designed for 90 minutes to two hours, and a review of it with our product managers.

What We Offer Remote-first environment Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises Modern AI tech stack and freedom to experiment High-velocity team where you will constantly learn and scale your skills High autonomy and ownership - we care about outcomes, not hours AI-first, collaborative, no-bureaucracy culture with a technically strong, international team 20 working days of PTO per year US holidays and additional days off Professional development reimbursement

Track progress on strategic initiatives through dashboards and periodic reviews, flagging risks, identifying root causes for deviations, and proposing corrective actions to meet KPI targets.

Analytical skills: Proven ability to build and interpret operational models in Excel and to manipulate large datasets using SQL or Python for business insights.

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

description:
About Hilbert

Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies.

The problem you are hired to solve

Hilbert's pipeline comes from Executive dinners, advisor firesides at the office, briefings at the customer's offices, side events at conferences. Events and warm introductions produce most of the deals that reach a second meeting.

Today those rooms happen when a founder or a regional sales leader makes them happen. There is no calendar, no owner, no follow-up standard and no count of which room produced which meeting. The Americas pipeline spans the United States, Mexico, Brazil and the Andean markets, and the sellers in each of them are building their own event plans from scratch.

That is this role: own the Americas event programme end to end, decide what goes on it, and measure it on the budget-holder meetings it produces.

What the role is

The Field Marketing Manager owns the strategy and the execution of every in-person and live-audience programme in the Americas. The job has two halves.

The first is the outside calendar: which conferences and industry events Hilbert joins, at what level, and what it does there. You recommend the list with the reasoning, and then you run each one, from the sponsorship decision to the side event, the speaker slots, the meeting schedule and the on-site execution.

The second is the programmes Hilbert hosts itself: executive dinners in the hub cities, advisor and investor firesides and podcast recordings at the office, customer roundtables and webinars. You design the format, the audience and the guest list, propose it, and then produce every part of it, including the promotion and the follow-up that turn attendance into meetings.

You plan both halves with the regional sales leaders, run them yourself, and report what each one produced. You are the first field marketer in the Americas. Your counterpart in EMEA runs the same programme there, and you build the shared playbook together.

What the role is not


Not content production. The founders and the product marketing lead decide what Hilbert says publicly and write the materials. You decide where it is said, to whom, and what happens the next morning.
Not paid acquisition. Hilbert runs no paid demand programmes today and this role does not start one.


The impact you will have


Decide the Americas calendar for the year with the regional sales leaders: which outside events to join, which events to host and in which office cities, which accounts in the room, and what each one has to produce. Recommend it with the reasoning and own it once agreed.
Run the executive dinner series in the hub cities, with guest lists drawn from target accounts and late-stage deals, and a follow-up plan agreed with the sellers before the invitations go out.
Own Hilbert's presence at the conferences you chose, from the sponsorship decision to the side event, the speaker slots, the meeting schedule and the on-site execution.
Design and produce the office programmes: advisor and investor firesides, live-audience podcast recordings, customer roundtables and webinars. You propose the format and the guest, and then you produce the whole thing, from the invitation to the recording to what is published afterwards.
Run pre-event targeting and post-event follow-up with sellers so that attendance becomes meetings within the week, not the quarter.
Manage vendors, venues, budgets and the partners who co-host with Hilbert.
Promote every programme through the channels Hilbert uses, LinkedIn and the newsletter among them, within the review process the company sets for public content.
Track every programme in the CRM: invited, attended, met, advanced. Report it monthly and change the calendar on what the numbers say.
Write the playbook, so that a dinner in Mexico City runs to the same standard as one in New York, and so that the next region can copy it.


How you are measured


Meetings with budget holders at target accounts that trace to a programme you ran.
Late-stage deals that advanced within thirty days of an event their buyer attended.
Cost per qualified meeting, by format.
Programmes delivered on the date and budget agreed.


What we look for


Four or more years in field marketing or event marketing at a B2B technology company with an enterprise sales motion, with end-to-end ownership of programmes from guest list to follow-up.
Has built an event strategy, not only executed one. Can show a calendar they designed, what they chose to join, what they chose to host, what they turned down, and what each produced.
Has run executive dinners and small, senior rooms and can show which meetings and deals came out of them. Has also run a conference presence with speakers, side events and a meeting schedule.
Has designed and produced an owned format from nothing: a dinner series, a podcast, a fireside or a webinar programme that ran more than once because it worked.
Works as a partner to sellers: plans the room with them, holds them to the follow-up, and is trusted with the account list.
Operationally exact. Vendors, venues, budgets, registration, name badges and the follow-up list are all yours, and you keep every one of them on track.
Writes a clear invitation, a clear brief for a speaker and a clear report for a sales leader.
Fluent in English and Spanish. The Americas programme runs in both.
Comfortable at startup pace, with a programme to build, no agency behind you at first, and a founder's calendar to work around.
Able to travel around 30 percent across the United States and Latin America.


Nice to have: Portuguese; experience with HubSpot; a network among CMOs and growth leaders in retail, grocery, QSR or banking; experience at a company that sold to the same buyers Hilbert sells to; experience building a field programme from nothing.

Your first ninety days


Weeks 1 to 3. Meet every seller in the Americas and read the pipeline. Audit the events run so far and what they produced. Take over the next dinner already on the calendar.
Weeks 4 to 8. Recommend the Americas calendar through the next two quarters: the outside events to join, the programmes to host, and why. Run two programmes end to end, with follow-up tracked in the CRM.

You will inherit a brand system, a target-account list, an advisor network that opens doors and a track record of dinners that worked. You will not inherit a calendar or a team. Both are deliberate.

Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

Job Description

The Client Insights & Delivery (CID) Analyst is a foundational role within the Global Nielsen Campaign Analytics team, focused on delivering actionable recommendations that drive client success and market impact.

As a member of this fast-paced, client-facing team, your primary responsibility is to work directly with media companies and advertisers to understand campaign objectives, advise on study setup, and provide performance analysis. You will assist in designing studies to measure ad effectiveness across all media platforms (digital, social, streaming, and podcasting) and perform deep-dive custom analyses under the guidance of senior members, all while maintaining a high level of quality assurance throughout every step of the process.

Business Objectives: Help translate broad business needs into specific, measurable research questions that can be solved by Nielsen solutions.
Research & Analysis: Design, execute, and present detailed research analyses, primarily focused on test vs. control methodology to determine the lift driven by measured campaigns.
Client Delivery: Use Product knowledge to support clients in designing and executing studies. Analytically consult with clients on the results, ensuring insights and action-oriented solutions are delivered.
Quality Assurance: Perform rigorous QA checks on test setup, data quality, and presentation materials to ensure best practices are strictly followed.
Collaboration & Problem Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate issues, find the root cause, and proactively resolve them with appropriate parties.
Project Management: Maintain accurate records of study timelines, milestones, and presentation dates, keeping all relevant internal and external stakeholders updated.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Analyst who will:


Quantify the success of marketing initiatives and deliver actionable insights that enable MFG teams to innovate and improve their work. 
Lead the collection, cleaning, analysis, and evaluation of marketing data, applying measurement methodologies such as A/B testing, Matched Market Tests, and statistical validation. 
Champion real-time data quality assurance, input, and formatting to support the successful implementation of media measurement initiatives. 
Proactively identify and resolve program and project issues, escalating them appropriately when necessary. 
Transform complex data into clear, visually compelling presentations. 
Communicate findings through effective data storytelling, translating advertising campaign results into actionable insights and recommendations. 
Build knowledge across different practices to tailor insights and recommendations to specific business and client needs. 
Stay current on MFG’s product offerings and understand how they influence analytics and measurement. 
Support and occasionally manage conversations with vendors and clients. 


Skills And Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Technology, Marketing, Advertising, or a related field, with a 3.0 GPA or equivalent professional experience. 
C1 English proficiency or equivalent, with the ability to communicate effectively in professional environments. 
1–3 years of professional experience in a marketing analytics-based role, preferably within a media agency. 
Experience or exposure to digital media execution, including Search, Social, and Programmatic channels. 
Understanding of the measurement of both Brand and Direct Response marketing campaigns. 
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Google Workspace is a plus. 
Experience with core advertising platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, and CM360. 
Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a highly organized and efficient manner. 
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present data and recommendations clearly. 
Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a natural affinity for numbers and data-driven problem-solving. 
Experience with generative AI tools such as Gemini and ChatGPT is a plus. 
Experience with programming languages such as R, SQL, and Python is a plus. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality and must be performed from any location within Mexico or Colombia. Only candidates residing in either country who are legally authorized to work there may apply. Remote work from outside Mexico or Colombia, including relocation abroad under a remote work contract, is not permitted under any circumstances.

title: Junior / Semi Senior Marketing Analyst
description:
Azumo is looking for a highly motivated AI-Powered Marketing Analyst to join our marketing team and help grow the Azumo brand and business.

The role is fully remote across Latin America , aligned to your working day.

We are looking for someone who is hands-on, creative, curious, and already uses tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI platforms as part of their daily work.

This is a practical, execution-focused role covering content, social media, AI search visibility, marketing analytics, and marketing operations. You will use AI throughout your workflow to research, create, design, analyze, automate, and improve marketing initiatives.

Your focus will be Azumo. You will learn about our business, customers, services, and market and use that knowledge to expand our reach, strengthen our brand, and generate new opportunities.

You will work closely with the marketing, sales, and leadership teams and have access to leading paid AI, marketing, content, analytics, and creative tools.

What We’re Looking For

We care about how you work, not just which tools you have used.

We want someone who can take an idea and turn it into something real. You should be comfortable researching a topic, creating the content and visuals, publishing or launching the work, measuring the results, and improving the next iteration.

AI should already be a natural part of that process for you.

At the same time, we are not looking for someone who simply generates content and publishes it. Strong judgment, creativity, attention to quality, and an understanding of the audience are essential.

Azumo offers an opportunity to build your marketing career inside a technology company where AI is part of the everyday work.

You Will Have The Opportunity To

Access leading paid AI, marketing, analytics, content, and creative tools.

Work across social media, content, analytics, GEO/AEO, and emerging AI marketing channels.

Experiment with new tools and approaches in real marketing initiatives.

Focus on growing one company and one brand: Azumo.

Work Closely With Experienced Team Members And Company Leadership.

Take ownership of projects and see the direct impact of your work.

Receive training and mentored career development.

Develop skills in emerging areas of marketing as AI changes how people search, discover, and evaluate companies.

Responsibilities

As part of the Azumo marketing team, you will:

Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools daily for research, content creation, creative development, analysis, and marketing operations.

Create and repurpose content for LinkedIn and other social media channels, including posts, graphics, carousels, and short-form content.

Create AI-generated images, videos, and other visual content using modern AI creative tools.

Develop and improve articles, case studies, newsletters, presentations, one-pagers, landing pages, and other marketing assets.

Implement GEO and AEO strategies to improve Azumo’s visibility in AI-powered search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

Monitor how Azumo and its competitors appear across traditional and AI search, identify content gaps, and turn those insights into actionable content improvements.

Use AI and analytics tools to build recurring reports covering traffic, social media, campaigns, leads, conversions, AI search visibility, and other relevant marketing KPIs.

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing tasks and improve existing workflows.

Help maintain and update Azumo’s website when needed.

Support other marketing initiatives in collaboration with the marketing, sales, and leadership teams.

Requirements

Mandatory Qualifications

Expert-level English proficiency, both written and conversational.

3+ years of hands-on marketing experience, along with practical experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.

Strong, well-rounded understanding of marketing language, principles and strategy.

Experience creating content for LinkedIn and other social media channels, such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Reddit, or similar platforms.

Comfortable working with marketing data, KPIs, reporting, and performance analysis.

Strong judgment, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to improve AI-generated work before publication.

Ability to evaluate marketing ideas critically and distinguish between activity, engagement, and meaningful business impact.

Other Qualifications

Ability to connect marketing activities to business objectives and understand how different marketing channels work together.

Experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar generative AI tools for research, content creation, design, video production, analysis and marketing operations.

Working experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub.

Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of projects in a remote environment.

Understanding of GEO, AEO, SEO, and AI search visibility.

Experience with paid advertising, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing Ads, or emerging AI advertising platforms.

Experience with Webflow or a similar website content management system.

Experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Webmaster Tools and similar analytics platforms.

Experience creating AI-assisted workflows or marketing automations.

The AI-Powered Marketing Analyst will work remotely. Compensation will be commensurate with experience and candidate potential.

Company Benefits Include

Paid time off

100% remote-first culture (work anywhere in Latin America)

U.S. Holidays

Training

Mentored career development

USD remuneration

Profit Share Program

Access to premium AI and marketing tools

Maternity coverage

Based in San Francisco, California, Azumo is a software development company helping organizations build intelligent applications using modern technologies in AI, data, cloud, web, and mobile.

We work with organizations around the world and believe that great talent can come from anywhere.

At Azumo, we strive for excellence and strongly believe in professional and personal growth. We want each individual to be successful and aim to help each person achieve their goals while at Azumo and beyond.

title: Senior Marketing Analyst | Channel Partner B2B
description:
Skeelo Ciudad de México, Ciudad de México, Mexico

Skeelo es una plataforma digital de lectura que conecta a las personas con e-books, audiolibros y minibooks en una experiencia accesible y personalizada. Desde 2019, utilizamos la tecnología como un medio para democratizar el acceso a la lectura y ampliar su impacto en el desarrollo de las personas.

Creemos que leer va más allá del ocio: es una herramienta poderosa para ampliar horizontes, fortalecer el pensamiento crítico e impulsar el desarrollo humano.

Estamos distribuidos y distribuidas en Brasil y en el mundo, impulsados por la innovación, la agilidad y el aprendizaje continuo, valorando la diversidad y transformando la lectura para adaptarla a la vida de las personas. Hacemos todo esto con transparencia en las relaciones, valentía para innovar, enfoque en alta performance, mirada constante en encantar a clientes y lectores, y entregas ágiles que marcan la diferencia.

Nuestro modelo de trabajo es remote first, aprovechando lo mejor del home office: autorresponsabilidad con autonomía. Sin embargo, también creemos en la conexión y en el intercambio que generan los encuentros presenciales; por eso, realizamos algunos encuentros en São Paulo – SP para fortalecer la conexión con los demás Skeelers. Pero tranquila/o, Skeelo siempre organiza todo por nosotros.

¡El equipo de Marketing necesita a alguien y queremos que seas parte de nuestro equipo!

¿Tu misión? Garantizar la excelencia operativa y el desempeño de las alianzas B2B de Skeelo. Serás la persona responsable de los procesos, cronogramas e indicadores, transformando la planificación estratégica en campañas ejecutadas con calidad. - Advanced proficiency in English.

- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

description:

Viva Talent · Remote (LATAM) · Reports to our Co-CEO

You'll build and improve the systems that connect Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, from first touch through expansion. You’ll use data to spot what’s slowing growth, recommend our next growth bets, and work with department heads to implement improvements and track their impact.




This is a fully hands-on role with no direct reports.

Define how Marketing and Sales work together. Establish lead qualification criteria (MQLs and SQLs), scoring, ideal-customer filters, routing, and follow-up SLAs, and track speed-to-lead.

Connect Sales and Customer Success. Ensure post-sale information is captured in HubSpot, bring customer health and usage signals into view, and track expansion opportunities in the pipeline.
Own the RevOps improvement roadmap. Identify and prioritize systems and process improvements that remove bottlenecks, reduce manual work, and improve revenue performance.
Build and implement AI-enabled workflows. Automate repetitive GTM work and validate the accuracy and value of the outputs.
Enable growth initiatives. Turn approved recommendations into workable processes with department heads, then monitor adoption and results.
Recommend growth and investment priorities. Identify opportunities to accelerate Viva’s core growth metric and recommend where to focus resources based on expected impact, speed to results, risks, and trade-offs.




Who you are

5+ years in Revenue Operations, with hands-on ownership of systems and processes across the customer lifecycle.
C1 English and executive communication skills. You explain recommendations clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and align stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
You’ve built or significantly improved RevOps systems and processes (0-1 and 1-n), with the ability to take work from identifying the problem through implementation.
Hands-on HubSpot expertise, including lifecycle configuration, data governance, integrations, and automation.
Strong commercial judgment and independence. You identify priorities, weigh risks and trade-offs, and make recommendations that influence growth and investment decisions.
Advanced, hands-on AI and automation expertise. You’ve built and deployed workflows that significantly reduce manual work and expand what you can deliver independently, while validating accuracy and results.




Helpful experience: Working in a startup or lean team; direct sales or customer-facing experience; and familiarity with Clay, Zapier/Make/n8n, and advertising conversion integrations.




Why you'll want this

Viva’s ready for the next stage of growth, and you’ll be a key player, working alongside our Co-CEO and department heads.

You’ll have the autonomy to find our next bets, guide where we invest, and turn insights into action, helping us actually create more career opportunities for women across Latin America.

100% remote work, forever.
Competitive compensation with reviews every six months and performance bonuses.

Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.

A focused process: application → initial interview → a practical skills assessment → hiring manager interview → final interview. We’ll share the details as you progress and respect your time.

title: Membership Manager - Soho House Los Cabos
skills: Upholds Soho House brand standards
Be responsible for the management and relationships of our members and committee
Assist in generating applications for waitlist, through their network and knowledge of the creative industries
Reports to work as scheduled, well groomed, and ready to be in position.
Manages and interacts with members on a daily basis through various means of communication
Maintains professional relationships with all coworkers and guests.
Maintains a positive attitude to guest and member needs- attentiveness to service, responding positively to guest’s needs, ensuring timely resolution.
Resolving member issues, concerns, ensuring follow up.
Responsible for generating daily report of ongoings and feedback of the club

Play a central role, with guidance from the Head of Membership and Membership Director, LATAM, in the maintenance and management of the membership committee, spread across all the major creative industries, made up of both men and women, of different ages/experience levels and from different parts of the city and beyond.
Support Head of Membership to review all new member applications, meeting applicants for coffee or virtual chats
Day to day manage the membership admin team. Liaise when necessary to resolve any issues with cards, payments or applicant paperwork.
Supporting membership team with retention of members, following up resignations and freezes

Maintain a constant presence in the club, being the ‘face’ of the house to members. Ensure you meet all new members where possible, explaining your role and allowing them to contact you if they choose.

Play an active part in the creation and implementation of the members events program, helping to ensure that events are well planned (by the events manager) and communicated (by communications manager). Make sure members can host or help with events (where applicable) as well as suggest new event formats.
Welcome new members in house, host new member introductions to ensure they understand the club rules and their membership.
Promote the club directly to appropriate new members through tours around the facilities and permitting choice individuals to experience the club via guest listing.

Engage in the local creative and club scenes, events, parties, launches and social settings, developing contacts, networking and building awareness about the club, its facilities, your role, and how new contacts might join.

When appropriate, facilitate access to the club for visiting high profile celebrities and personalities (as well as a limited number of guests), ensuring they receive good service and enjoy their time as our guests.
For major events, both on and off site, play a central role in putting together the guest list(s), ensuring members and VIPs get access, as applicable.

Educate the Soho House management and staff about how to generate applications from potential new members and identify new committee members. Ensure their suggestions are processed through the committee meetings.
3+ years’ relative experience with a proven track record of leading a professional, efficient, high quality, service-oriented operation.
2+ years Management experience.

A long-term city resident with extensive knowledge of the local area. Knowledge of Los Cabos and has a personal network of contacts in different industries including but limited to; art, film, television, music, media and culinary, etc..
Flexible schedule including weekends, holidays as well as the ability to travel and attend various social functions in the Los Angeles area.
A sophisticated communicator with high standards of performance together with excellent communication, problem solving and listening skills.
A charismatic, confident creative individual with in-depth knowledge of the local market place.
Experience with dealing with celebrities and high-profile events.
Ability to work effectively under time constraints and deadlines.
Ability to create strong relationships with guests, members, and staff.

Monitorear y analizar el rendimiento de los canales digitales, utilizando métricas para optimizar estrategias.

Colaborar estrechamente con otros departamentos para asegurar la coherencia de los mensajes en todos los puntos de contacto digitales.

Dominio de herramientas de gestión de redes sociales, SEO/SEM básico y plataformas de email marketing.

Nuestro cliente está buscando un Responsable de Comunicación Digital experimentado y proactivo para unirse a su equipo en un entorno completamente remoto. Serás el pilar de nuestra estrategia de comunicación online, responsable de desarrollar e implementar iniciativas digitales que fortalezcan nuestra marca, interactúen con nuestra audiencia y apoyen nuestros objetivos de negocio. Este rol requiere una profunda comprensión del panorama digital, la capacidad de crear contenido atractivo y la habilidad para gestionar eficazmente todas nuestras plataformas online. Valoramos la iniciativa, la creatividad y la capacidad de trabajar de forma autónoma y colaborativa a distancia, asegurando que nuestra presencia digital sea coherente y impactante en todo momento.

Diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia de comunicación digital integral, incluyendo redes sociales, email marketing, y sitio web.

Crear, curar y gestionar contenido digital atractivo y alineado con la marca.

Monitorear y analizar el rendimiento de los canales digitales, utilizando métricas para optimizar estrategias.

Gestionar la reputación online y la interacción con la comunidad en todas las plataformas digitales.

Colaborar estrechamente con otros departamentos para asegurar la coherencia de los mensajes en todos los puntos de contacto digitales.

Experiencia demostrable como Responsable de Comunicación Digital o en roles similares enfocados en lo digital.

Dominio de herramientas de gestión de redes sociales, SEO/SEM básico y plataformas de email marketing.

Excelentes habilidades de redacción, edición y comunicación en español.

Capacidad probada para gestionar proyectos de comunicación digital de principio a fin en un entorno remoto.

Fuerte pensamiento analítico y orientación a la consecución de resultados medibles.
